user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Used to surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web pages to show them in ChatGPT search answers.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validates safety and compliance of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.opt_out: Not specified in documentation.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content potentially used for training AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Performs user-initiated actions and browsing in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Visits web pages when initiated by user prompts or GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated action; robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to train generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Public web content potentially contributing to model training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive in robots.txt for ClaudeBot.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content at user direction in Claude.
user_agents.scope: Websites accessed through user-initiated requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive in robots.txt for Claude-User.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes web content to enhance search relevance and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Online content indexed for user search optimization.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive in robots.txt for Claude-SearchBot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Builds Google search indexes, performs product-specific crawls, and conducts analysis.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, Google News, and other search features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images, logos, and favicons for Google products.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and image features across Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent Googlebot-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video content for video-related search features.
user_agents.scope: Affects video-related Google Search features and other video-dependent products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent Googlebot-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls news content for Google News platforms.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google News products, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent Googlebot-News in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls shopping and commerce content for Google Shopping.
user_agents.scope: Affects all surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Executes search testing tools and URL inspections.
user_agents.scope: Affects Rich Result Test and URL inspection in Search Console; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent Google-InspectionTool in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for product teams fetching public content and internal R&D.
user_agents.scope: Used by various product teams for internal research and development without affecting specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for internal and general uses.
user_agents.scope: Optimized version of GoogleOther for images without affecting specific search products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent GoogleOther-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for internal and general uses.
user_agents.scope: Optimized version of GoogleOther for videos without affecting specific search products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent GoogleOther-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Executes crawls requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Affects crawls for building Vertex AI Agents; no effect on Google Search or other products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent Google-CloudVertexBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled site content for Gemini training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Affects training Gemini models for Gemini Apps and Vertex AI API, and Search grounding.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for user-agent Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes web information to deliver search experiences.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes web information to deliver search experiences.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple products and collects data for foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling and rendering for Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and Apple Intelligence.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use noindex robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for training Apple generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Applies to data usage for training general purpose foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps to display previews
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays app or website information like title and images
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, but may bypass for security checks

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improves Meta AI search result quality for users
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance and cite sources in responses
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow meta-webindexer in robots.txt

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improves advertising and business-related products and services
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web for advertising and other business-related use cases
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow meta-externalads in robots.txt

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Trains foundation AI models and indexes content for products
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web for training AI models and direct content indexing
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow meta-externalagent in robots.txt

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches links at user request and evaluates agentic AI
user_agents.scope: Supports agentic AI capabilities including navigating websites to complete tasks
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are user-requested

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Indexes web content for Bing search and downstream services.
user_agents.scope: Public web pages crawled for search indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Bingbot.

user_agents.name: Microsoft-BingCopilot
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content to answer queries in Microsoft Copilot.
user_agents.scope: Content accessed to ground Copilot AI interactions.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Microsoft-BingCopilot.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Used to improve products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls host-level web content for Amazon products, services, and AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt allow/disallow directives and noarchive meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Used to improve search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for search eligibility; does not crawl for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt allow/disallow directives and noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions such as fetching live web information for queries.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live web information on user's behalf; excludes generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide open datasets for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Crawls a randomly selected subset of the web to build open datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow: / for User-agent CCBot in robots.txt or request opt-out registry.
